author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The University of Rhode Island football team opens its Pawtucket home schedule Saturday against Elon in a noon kickoff at Centreville Bank Stadium. URI is billing the game as its Welcome Back event for the campus community, with the Rams beginning another season after winning consecutive Coastal Athletic Association championships.

The Pawtucket setting gives the program a different home-stage atmosphere while its usual Kingston venue undergoes major work. URI is offering discounted admission to faculty and staff, and the event is designed to reconnect students and employees with the team at the start of the academic year. The university advised attendees to review stadium information before traveling.

Elon provides an immediate conference-level test for a Rhode Island team carrying higher expectations after back-to-back titles. An opening game can also reveal how quickly new starters and adjusted units have settled into their roles. The noon start makes transportation and arrival planning especially relevant for supporters traveling from Kingston and elsewhere in the state. Saturday’s result will offer the first competitive measure of URI’s bid to sustain its recent run of success.
dek: The back-to-back CAA champion Rams begin their season against Elon at Centreville Bank Stadium in Pawtucket.
headline: URI opens Pawtucket home slate against Elon
